strings.source_en: With  all  this  around  me,  it  feels  like  being  trapped  in  the  snow-covered  mountains  was  just  a  nightmare.%K%P

strings.source_en: The  Aomori  prefectural  police  announced  the  recent  discovery  of  the  remains  of  three  men  and  women  on  Aomori's  Mount  Akakura,%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『今年１月、青森県朱倉岳にＨＡＬ１８便が墜落し２７人が死亡した事故に関連して、』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『올해 1월 아오모리현 아카쿠라산에 HAL18편이 추락해 27명이 사망한 사고와 관련하여,』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: believed  to  be  victims  of  the  crash  of  Flight  HAL18,  which  claimed  27  lives  last  January.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『青森県警は新たに男女３人の遺体を収容したことを発表した。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『아오모리현 경찰은 새로 남녀 3명의 시신을 수습했다고 발표했다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: As  they  had  undergone  extensive  decomposition  over  a  period  of  six  months,  the  identities  of  the  bodies  are  unclear,%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『収容された遺体は、すでに死後６ヶ月が経過しているために腐乱が激しく、まだ身元をはっきりと断定できていない、としながらも、』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『수습된 시신은 사망한 지 이미 6개월이 지나 부패가 심해 아직 신원을 확실히 단정할 수 없지만,』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: but  they  are  assumed  to  be  the  last  three  unaccounted  for  among  the  missing  passengers  and  crew  members  on  HAL18.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『ＨＡＬ１８便に乗っていた乗員・乗客のうち、いまだ発見されていなかった残る３人にほぼ間違いないとしている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『HAL 18편에 탑승한 승무원과 승객 중 아직 발견되지 않았던 나머지 3명이 거의 확실하다고 밝혔다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: The  bodies  were  discovered  one  kilometer  east  of  the  Mount  Akakura  shelter  cabin.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『遺体はいずれも、朱倉岳避難小屋から東へ１ｋｍ離れた場所で見つかっており、』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『시신은 모두 아카쿠라산 대피소에서 동쪽으로 1km 떨어진 곳에서 발견됐으며,』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: It  has  been  confirmed  that  the  three  bodies  sustained  many  lacerations  in  an  avalanche,  and  it  is  probable  that  they  survived  for  some  time  after  the  crash.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『遺体には雪崩に巻き込まれた際に受ける裂傷も多数確認されていることから、３人は墜落直後は生存していたものと考えられる。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『시신에서 눈사태에 휩쓸릴 때 생긴 열상이 다수 확인된 점으로 미루어, 세 사람은 추락 직후에는 생존했던 것으로 보인다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: However,  due  to  the  location  being  far  away  from  the  route  down  the  mountain,  the  Aomori  police  investigation  into  their  movements  on  the  day  of  their  death  will  continue.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『しかし、発見場所は下山ルートからは離れているため、遭難者の死亡当日の足取りについて、青森県警では調査を進めている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『하지만 발견 장소가 하산 경로에서 벗어나 있어, 아오모리현 경찰은 조난자들이 사망 당일 보인 행적을 조사하고 있다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: According  to  the  Aomori  Meteorological  Observatory,%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『青森気象観測所によると、』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: an  avalanche  affecting  this  area  of  Mount  Akakura  occurred  on  January  17th,  2011,  at  around  6:53  AM.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『この時期に朱倉岳の該当箇所周辺で発生した雪崩は、２０１１年１月１７日午前６時５３分であることがわかっている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『당시 아카쿠라산의 해당 지점 부근에서 발생한 눈사태는 2011년 1월 17일 오전 6시 53분에 일어난 것으로 밝혀졌다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: After  analyzing  the  traces  left  at  the  Mount  Akakura  shelter  cabin,  it  was  concluded  that  those  who  had  used  it  survived  for  seven  days  after  the  crash.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『朱倉岳避難小屋に残されていた痕跡とも照らし合わせると、３人はおよそ７日間を生き延びたことになる。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『아카쿠라산 대피소에 남은 흔적과 대조하면, 세 사람은 약 7일간 살아남았던 셈이다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: The  only  survivor,  Kusuda  Yuni-kun  (11),  was  miraculously  rescued.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『なお、唯一の生存者として楠田ゆにくん（１１）が奇蹟的に救助されている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『한편 유일한 생존자인 쿠스다 유니 군(11)은 기적적으로 구조됐다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: Yuni-kun's  mental  state  has  not  yet  stabilized,  even  after  half  a  year.  He  has  stubbornly  remained  silent.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『ゆにくんの精神状態は、半年を過ぎたいまも安定せず、かたくなに口を閉ざしている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『유니 군은 반년이 지난 지금도 정신 상태가 불안정해 완강히 입을 다물고 있다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: The  Aomori  prefectural  police  are  still  waiting  for  Yuni-kun's  recovery  to  inquire  about  the  details  surrounding  the  incident.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『青森県警は、ゆにくんの回復を待って詳しい状況を聞くことにしている。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『아오모리현 경찰은 유니 군이 회복되기를 기다린 뒤 자세한 상황을 들을 방침이다.』%K%P
strings.provenance: Japanese PSP-to-PC exact source alignment; reused reviewed base Korean

strings.source_en: The  horrific  crash  of  Flight  18,  with  the  discovery  of  the  three  bodies,  claimed  30  lives  out  of  the  31  crew  members  and  passengers  aboard.%K%P
strings.source_jp: 『１８便の墜落事故では、今回の３人の遺体の発見により、乗員・乗客３１人中、３０人が亡くなるという大惨事となった。』%K%P
strings.target_ko: 『18편 추락 사고는 이번에 시신 3구가 발견되면서 승무원과 승객 31명 중 30명이 사망한 대참사로 남게 됐다.』%K%P
